title: BackTrend: Evaluating Scientific Weak-Signal Prediction via Backward Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2609.24921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific weak signals are early, low-visibility research directions that later become central to mature scientific topics, yet existing resources such as trend tracking, citation forecasting, and foresight reports rarely provide validated reference sets that link concrete early precursors to later paradigms. We introduce BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark in which, given a mature target topic and a temporal evidence constraint, systems must recover two types of precursors: problem-space signals, underrecognized research problems, and solution-space signals, emerging methods for known problems. BackTrend contains 25 mature target topics in artificial intelligence and machine learning and 66 human-validated weak signals, reconstructed from large-scale literature by grounding each candidate in its 2019-2024 publication-frequency trajectory. translated_title: BackTrend：通过逆向重构评估科学弱信号预测
translated_abstract: 科学弱信号是指那些早期可见度较低、但后来成为成熟科学主题核心的研究方向。然而，现有资源（如趋势追踪、引用预测和前瞻报告）很少提供经过验证的参考集，将具体的早期先兆与后来的科学范式联系起来。我们提出了BackTrend，这是一个回溯性基准测试：给定一个成熟的目标主题和时间证据约束，系统必须恢复两类先兆信号——问题空间信号（未被充分认识的研究问题）和解决方案空间信号（针对已知问题的新兴方法）。BackTrend包含人工智能和机器学习领域的25个成熟目标主题和66个经人工验证的弱信号，这些信号通过将每个候选信号锚定于其2019至2024年的发表频率轨迹，从大规模文献中逆向重构而来。我们使用语义匹配和……（原文此处截断）评估了前沿大语言模型、RAG系统和智能体研究系统。
tldr: 该论文提出BackTrend基准，通过从25个成熟的AI/机器学习主题逆向重构出66个经人工验证的科学弱信号（包括问题空间和解决方案空间信号），用以评估大语言模型、RAG系统和智能体研究系统预测早期低可见度研究方向的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark that reconstructs 66 human-validated scientific weak signals (problem-space and solution-space) from 25 mature AI/ML topics to evaluate the ability of frontier LLMs, RAG systems, and agentic research systems to predict early, low-visibility research directions.
